reglas.titulo: Changes of status across the pools
reglas.alcance: These rules apply to every pool.
reglas.ayuda: Choose a starting status and the changes allowed from it. Mandatory changes follow the governing rules and cannot be removed. Review the full set before publishing.
reglas.carga_error: The rules could not be loaded. Please try again.
reglas.denegado: You do not have permission for this operation.
reglas.sin_destinos: No changes are available from this status.
reglas.conjunto_publicacion: Changes that will be published for every pool
reglas.sin_transiciones_publicacion: No status changes will be allowed.
reglas.retiradas_publicacion: Changes that will no longer be allowed
reglas.sin_diferencias_publicacion: The options are unchanged. They will be published under the current limits.

reglas.ya_publicada: This publication was already recorded. Continue to see which changes currently take effect.
reglas.incierto: The result could not be confirmed. You can repeat this exact publication without changing its details.
reglas.conflicto: The rules changed while you were editing. Reload them and review the changes.
reglas.invalida: This selection cannot be published. Review the rules and reload them.
reglas.solo_lectura: You can view these rules. Publishing them requires HR permission.
